title: The Coat That Floated Down
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Elisha stayed by Elijah
and walked with him each day.
They reached a river; with his coat
he tapped; it split away.

[Chorus]
God always has a prophet here
to lead us on our way.
When one is done, another comes;
we follow him today.

[Verse 2]
Then horses made of fire came down,
a chariot of flame!
Elijah whirled up, up, and up,
and down his coat then came.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
Now close your eyes and rest, my love,
the whirlwind’s gone to sleep.
Elisha trusted; so can you:
the Lord your soul will keep.

[Chorus]
mood: Rising music. A gentle upward lift under the voice, each phrase floating a little higher, like a whirlwind carrying something light toward the sky. The chorus lands warm and steady, the way the coat comes back to earth for the next prophet. By the last verse the lift eases into a slow, low sway, the sky quiet and the child settled.
